plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Raymond Edward Johnson is credited on 65 distinct recordings across 13 programs from 1941-01-07 through 1971-10-15. Documented roles include performer on 40 recordings and host on 26 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Inner Sanctum Mysteries (host on 26 recordings and performer on 1 recording; 26 distinct recordings), Cloak and Dagger (performer on 16 recordings; 16 distinct recordings), X Minus One (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings), Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 4 recordings; 4 distinct recordings), Casey, Crime Photographer (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Dimension X (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Gang Busters (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), and Barrie Craig (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include The Inner Sanctum Host (25 portrayals).
